user.title: RTLPlayground switch
user.description: Address of the switch in its monitoring API VLAN and the API token (System > Monitoring API in the switch's web UI, or `api token` on its console). Home Assistant must be the allowed client.

data_description.host: The `api ip` address of the switch, not its management address.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The switch at {host} refused the token. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: The switch did not answer. Check the API address, the API VLAN, that the API is active and that Home Assistant is the allowed client.
error.invalid_auth: The switch refused the token. Is it the current token, and is this the API address (not the management address)?

abort.already_configured: This switch is already set up; address and token were updated.
abort.wrong_switch: That address belongs to a different switch.

data_description.counters: One extra request per port and poll.
data_description.rate_unit: Applies to every receive and transmit rate. Mbit/s is the usual network unit, MB/s the one of file transfers (1 MB/s = 8 Mbit/s).
